assessment: This article by Suner et al. investigated specific regulation of LPS-induced sepsis and mechanisms underlying resolution of inflammation. The authors focused on CPEB4 and TTP, two RNA-binding proteins, showing that they work in opposite manner to regulate RNA stability in macrophages and modulate inflammation. This is an interesting study that offers significant advance to the fields of sepsis-inflammation and post-transcriptional regulation of gene expression in inflammatory responses.
